TestDistributedAggregations::test_distri.description: 3-node cluster (vnodes, num_tokens=3, murmur3_ignore_msb_bits=1, smp 4), rf=2, counter table filled with 100K c-s user-profile inserts (10K in debug/coverage). Runs SELECT count(*) with enable_parallelized_aggregation=false, restarts the whole cluster with it set to true, reruns. Asserts both counts equal OPS, the non-parallel trace has no 'Dispatching mapreduce_request to 3 endpoints' / 'Dispatching N ranges' event, and the parallel trace has one. Guards the parallelized aggregation (mapreduce_service) feature, scylladb commit fe65122c.

origin.summary: Distributed aggregation tests (qa-tasks#779): count(*) with/without enable_parallelized_aggregation, compare results, trace forwarding, and (per PR body) timing.
